# Red-team UI audit: microcopy, component usage, layout and interaction states

> **STATUS:** REPORT. It decides nothing. `docs/HANDOFF.md` §3 outranks it, and
> the owner's rulings G3091 (pack-faithful, quiet) and G3193 (refused items are
> hidden) are applied as *givens*: a muted control with a `Coming soon` tooltip
> is **not** a finding here, and neither is an omitted refused control. Where the
> pack itself disagrees with a ruling (R7 "hatch, word and reason", R8 "the reason
> is still stated beside the control"), the ruling wins and the gap is noted, not
> scored.
>
> Audited 3 Oct 2026 against `origin/main` @ `79631f2e`. **No product code was changed.**
> Dimensions: **microcopy · component usage · layout, spacing and interaction states.**
> Owner's verdict being tested: *"not quite there yet, the UI style guide needs an audit."*

## How it was rendered

- `npm run build:frontend`, then the built bundle served same-origin in front of a
  real data plane (`startDataPlane()`, production authoriser, no test-auth flag),
  exactly as `tests/e2e/close-parity.shot.ts` does.
- A private PostgreSQL 16, schema reset, **`db/seeds/staging-demo-data.sql`** applied
  as the migrator (the pack's C1 scenario: 6 runs, 20 exceptions, proposals), plus
  two sessions on `ten_acme`: an operator holding `admit_source · view_exception ·
  assign_exception · view_document · view_dashboard` (display name *Mei Kato*), and a
  person holding **no** capability.
- Chromium (Playwright 1.55) at four widths: **1440** (wide), **1024** (mid),
  **800** (the "below 820px" band), **390** (narrow). The pack pages
  `C1 Close`, `E1 Errors`, `V3 Sign In` were rendered from `file://` at the same widths.
- Loading, 401/403/429/500/503 were produced by intercepting `/v1/**` in the browser
  (a delay, or a fulfilled status with a closed-vocabulary code). They show what the
  UI does *for* a status; they are not claims that the plane emits it on that path.
- Frames: `docs/build/ui-audit/screens/` — `pack-*` beside `app-*`. Capture script was
  scratch and is not committed.

Severity: **S1** misleads the reader or blocks a journey · **S2** visibly off-pack /
broken interaction · **S3** inconsistency a reviewer would flag · **S4** polish.

### Component usage against the 14 primitives

| # | Primitive | Built as | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Navigation shell | `ChromeBar` `nav.dests`, `aria-current` | OK at ≥1080; **absent** below (RC-07); no bottom tab bar |
| 2 | Chrome bar | `ChromeBar` | Composition OK; tenant/person content wrong (RC-12, RC-25); no narrow relocation (RC-06) |
| 3 | Command palette | `Soon` button | Planned; ⌘K inert (RC-22) |
| 4 | Breadcrumb | **none** — body link "Back to the register" | Ad-hoc; use `<Trail>` on finding and run pages (RC-08) |
| 5 | Account menu | hand-rolled `<details>` + `useOverlay` | Pack says *adopt shadcn DropdownMenu*; `<details>` has no `menu/menuitem` roles |
| 6 | Filter mechanism | `button[aria-pressed]` groups | OK shape; labels diverge (RC-18) |
| 7 | Table navigation | `<table>` with `tr[role=button]` | No `aria-sort`, no J/K, no single-axis scroller at mid (RC-07, RC-22) |
| 8 | Drawer | **not used** — evidence is an inline table row | Matches C1's own inline evidence; Ultra-tier "inline third column" not built |
| 9 | Modal | not used | Needed for Release-of-another (RC-04) |
| 10 | Tooltip | `Tooltip` via `Soon` | Good: script-owned, `aria-disabled`, focus+tap; placement unspecified (RC-30) |
| 11 | Toast | not used anywhere on product surfaces | Take/Release silent (RC-04) |
| 12 | Status bar | `StatusBar` in `Shell` only | Not on finding / run / setup pages (*"on every protected surface"*); slots differ (RC-21) |
| 13 | Route states | per-component strings | No shared `<RouteState>`; no `aria-busy` (RC-16, RC-17, RC-01) |
| 14 | Key-caps | `<kbd>` inside one `Soon` | Hidden <720 as specified; legend fused into one disabled control (RC-21) |

## What was not covered

- Setup as a tenant administrator (no admin session in the seed) and the proposal/approval
  flows (no UI exists to drive).
- Dark theme (R18) — not rendered.
- Real 401/403/429/500/503 from the plane on these paths — browser-fulfilled stand-ins only.
